name: Underworld Dreams
text: Whenever an opponent draws a card, Underworld Dreams deals 1 damage to that player.
flavor: "In the drowsy dark cave of the mind, dreams build their nest with fragments dropped from day's caravan."\n—Rabindranath Tagore
rulings: [{'date': '2004-10-04', 'text': 'If multiple cards are drawn at once, this card triggers once for each card drawn.'}, {'date': '2004-10-04', 'text': 'In a multi-player game, it affects all opponents.'}, {'date': '2020-01-24', 'text': 'If a spell or ability causes you to put cards into your hand without specifically using the word “draw,” it’s not a card drawn.'}]
